findings.detail: The fill-rate flag appears to count unfunded/undrawn debt commitment rows whose source Interest Rate cells are dashes, while funded debt rows in the same schedule carry explicit rates.

rationale: Raw SOI tables separate funded debt investments from unfunded debt investments. The header includes Reference, Spread, and Interest Rate columns; a representative funded row has SOFR, spread 6.25%, and interest rate 11.63%, while a representative unfunded/undrawn row in table 27 has dashes in Reference, Spread, and Interest Rate and rolls into Total Unfunded Debt Investments. Therefore the missing interest_rate values are source-blank unfunded commitments, not a data extraction error.
